source_scope.other_top_level_changes: New candidate ID, current-source TEST_FILES binding, journal constants/fields/operation enums and SOURCE_ONLY label. CLI main and DirectHTTPS.connect have unconditional preparation denials.

reviewed_behavior: Append-only exclusive unbuffered journal; one checked write then flush/fsync per magic/frame; durable bookkeeping advances only after successful fsync; failed writes/flush/fsync poison further append attempts.
4096 maximum byte snapshots plus six lifecycle frames, 4102 total; exact maximum logical journal size 8548576 bytes, enforced before writes. Terminal has capacity on the longest healthy path.

Writer rejects duplicate/out-of-order events. Reader validates digest chain, field types, schema, phase, counter monotonicity, sequence, lengths and frame/file limits; no scan-forward resynchronization.
Prefix counters are explicitly lower bounds and counters_complete=false. A journal, including a complete terminal frame, never independently authorizes success or static inspection.

Final checkpoint is attempted once only after confirmed journal closure, using exclusive creation, bounded serialization, checked write/flush/fsync/close. Failed close suppresses final output; parseable bytes after fsync/close failure do not override failed worker exit.

All original byte/hash/disk/time receive ordering is AST-identical. Only the save callback changes persistence sampling. The deliberate weaker process-crash evidence remains disclosed in the approved design.

Success requires the full original body/hash/count/fsync/close gates, current identity, consistent complete journal and final checkpoint, and confirmed zero worker exit with no timeout/error. Static worker_claim revalidates journal and supervisor evidence.

First bounded diagnostic remains primary; later failures are bounded secondary entries. Source-bound terminal failed records can preserve the first error when final JSON is missing, while checkpoint invalidity remains separately recorded and success stays false.

Original single-GET latch, disk/body limits, deadlines, watchdog and conservative partial cleanup are unchanged. Journal/final output use the same disk projection and budget; no retry, limit increase or evidence deletion is added.

resolved_findings.finding: Final output could bypass disk gating when DiskGuard construction failed.
resolved_findings.resolution: disk=None now fails before serialization/open with CHECKPOINT_INVALID at DISK_CHECK/FINAL_CHECKPOINT; the original construction failure remains primary.

resolved_findings.finding: Journal read_bytes could exceed the read cap after a stale stat.
resolved_findings.resolution: One bounded cap+1 raw read and one bounded one-byte EOF check, with checked close; oversize/short-read hidden suffix fails closed. No unbounded read_bytes remains in the journal reader.

resolved_findings.finding: Missing final JSON discarded an available journal terminal first error and prefix source identity was not checked.
resolved_findings.resolution: Crash recovery binds frames to report.final_source_sha256, retains a valid terminal failed first_error as primary, records CHECKPOINT_INVALID secondarily, and keeps the attempt failed.

resolved_findings.finding: Final close could return after deadline without another check.
resolved_findings.resolution: Post-close budget check runs with earliest-error preservation; a delayed close cannot leave successful finalization.

limitations: This is source-preparation acceptance, not authorization to activate or execute a live attempt. Candidate CLI and DirectHTTPS remain hard-disabled.
No live Windows reproduction, original-failure-cause finding, durability guarantee, download success, package installation/import, or real network-path execution is established.

The adapted suites exercise memory/fake paths on the new source. Ten obsolete before/after-write JSON cases are explicitly superseded; original historical fixture receipts are not reused as current passes.

Hard-disabled networking tests prove preparation refusal. They do not independently exercise an enabled real DNS/TLS/HTTP path; any enabled derivative still needs separate review and actual authority.
Final manifests, execution-authorization documents, copied deployment and later live-attempt binding are outside this source/test receipt.
